claims: Jaskirat Singh Rangi is a fictional character.
Ranveer Singh plays Jaskirat Singh Rangi in the 2026 Hindi action-spy film Dhurandhar: The Revenge.
Jaskirat Singh Rangi is a former Indian Army officer from the Punjab Regiment.
Jaskirat Singh Rangi becomes a ghost operative.
Jaskirat Singh Rangi infiltrates Pakistan as Hamza Ali Mazari to dismantle terrorist networks.
Jaskirat Singh Rangi's family is targeted by corrupt forces in India.
Jaskirat Singh Rangi is recruited from death row for a high-stakes undercover mission in Karachi, Pakistan.
Jaskirat Singh Rangi operates under the alias Hamza Ali Mazari.
Jaskirat Singh Rangi infiltrates the underworld gang of Rehman Dakait to gather intelligence and disrupt terrorist activities.
The Revenge is a sequel to a previous unnamed spy-thriller.
The Revenge is released in Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Malayalam, and Kannada.
The Revenge released in theatres on March 19, 2026.
